procedure: Restore synthetic image from original Harmony app history to system Pasteboard.
Explicitly send image from isolated paired Harmony app with automatic synchronization disabled.
Download PNG from authenticated desktop entry resource API and decode RGBA.
Reconstruct historical test PNG with filter type 0 and zlib level 6; its SHA-256 matches the pre-existing source fingerprint.
Compare every decoded RGBA byte between reconstructed source and received PNG.

reverseResend.interpretation: Remote-origin resend rejection; not successful reverse image transfer.

limits: Does not cover macOS system clipboard capture, a fresh desktop-origin image, large/HDR/multiple-format images, memory pressure or interrupted transfers.
The installed interop HAP uses local Engine development artifacts and emulator signing; not a formal release.
